Cases within a repository are correlated, and several targets can share one PR, so they are not independent trials.

selection_notes.t001: Introductions: git log -S and -G on route strings, reflection text and cors in packages/server/src/index.ts across all refs; advisory fetched (it names no fix). All six targets are covered, each in exactly one positive entry; GHSL-2023-245, 247 and 248 share a fix_reverted entry because their introductions are unusable (see that entry's caveats). benign_nearby and preexisting_touch query: git log --no-merges --since=2023-04-06 --until=2024-06-30 --all -G'createReadStream|path\.join|req\.params|res\.status\(404\)|getUserHome' -- packages/server/src/index.ts packages/server/src/utils/index.ts, giving 113 commits. NOT random: diffs to read were picked by subject and size, skipping most route-transition commits and anything large. f893edcc and 7a1d770b were picked to get main-line candidates after the first batch. 19 examined, 6 kept (8e1ef2d5, 5d25c35a, 7a1d770b, 7e84268f, 0eb16170, f893edcc), 13 rejected: eab8c19f (path.join of req.params.id into a recursive delete, appears to add a new vulnerability); aa5d1417 (same delete sink, chatflowid); 51f9f0be (adds a new reflected chatId); bb77e3f5 (adds a reflection line to a public route); b7cd38c8 (mkdir of a dirname from an unsanitized filename may widen a write primitive); 88451b6e (not on main, and an unparenthesized OR in a delete query that could not be ruled out without checking TypeORM); c07e908f (compares allowedOrigins to the Host header, an access-control bug); 44294d00 (moves encryption key lookup into package directories, security-relevant); 383f612e (subset of the 5d25c35a pattern, 3 lines); 4b5f7028 (only partly read, output truncated); 56b21862 and 20567037 (change public chatbot config responses and config persistence, not chosen because exposure was not fully assessed); a40a76eb (same shape as 0eb16170, branch-only). f7178074 and 6827a13e were queued but their diffs were not read, so they are not counted. Security fixes were chosen from a commit-message grep for xss, sanitiz, traversal, path inj, cors, security, CVE, GHSA, allowlist and whitelist; 3 kept; c00ae784 and bbb03b7b were read and not used; the rest were not examined in depth. No code was run; every exploitability statement comes from reading code. Evidence quotes, line numbers, absences, first-parent relations and sizes were checked by script against git objects.
selection_notes.t002: Pickaxe per target, scoped to target files (git log -S on gmsApiPath, AUTH_REDIRECT_URI_PARAM, redirectPath, 'Bad abstract class design', LEGACY_X_DATAHUB_ACTOR_HEADER, USER_ID_FIELD, PASSWORD_FIELD, .parse(, parseClaimsJws, AES, AES/ECB, pac4j, filterToCriteria, toCriterionString, computeEntityTypeWhereClause, withNewSession, 'Redirect location must be'); plus log --grep for security terms from 2022-09-15 to 2023-01-15 and v0.8.44..v0.8.45 on key paths. Control enumeration: git log --since=2021-08-01 --until=2024-06-01 --no-merges on AuthenticationController, Application, AuthServiceClient, AuthUtils, CentralLogoutController, AuthenticationManager, StatelessTokenService, NoOpAuthenticator gave 54 commits; Neo4jGraphService log since 2022-08 gave 35 commits. Those were triaged by subject and size, and 17 diffs were read in full: 11 kept, 6 rejected. Rejected: 12b199f6 (#7011, stores redirect_uri in pac4j REQUESTED_URL, which extends 077 to the post-SSO redirect, so it may worsen a target); 5974721697 (#5708, new error_msg query parameter shown on the login page allows message spoofing, unsure); 633119965d (#7532, disables URL encoding in proxy requests, could not rule out an effect on path handling); 10ea10ce (#6565, adds a parser helper whose use I did not confirm); 4fa3d63b (#16279, clean but redundant with secfix-redirect-domain); 011421df (#6036, clean but not needed). Bias disclosure: triage favoured diffs small enough to read fully, so controls skew small, apart from 9a74054b and d3c2a36d. Only 2 benign_nearby entries were kept; preexisting_touch and security_fix were easier to justify. Numbers: lines_added and lines_deleted are base-to-head as defined by the entry, so fix_reverted values are the mirror of the upstream commit (for example d13145e3 is upstream +80/-69, recorded +69/-80). All SHAs verified with git cat-file -t and each head has one parent. Nothing was executed; exploitability statements rest on code reading plus the advisory. Advisory discrepancy: its timeline says fixes shipped in v0.8.45, but from history that holds only for 076, 078, 079, 080, 081 and the partial 083. 086 was fixed 2022-12-08, 077 on 2024-01-09, 082 on 2025-07-02, and the 087 read path has no fix found. Overlap: the 2d29d0b1 pair also reintroduces 076 and 081; see that entry's caveats.

Read 11 diffs in detail and judged 3 from stats only. Accepted: d70da74b, a51fef59, 51b92a58, f8857650, c22d26aa, f04856f6, plus the fix. Positive decisions: every target has its own entry because the history is separate; no single commit introduces two targets. 4043ca1f (local uploader added) was considered as a shared GHSL-2024-182 + 186 entry and rejected: it swaps backends under callers wired by 0396bcf5 and earlier Fog code passed the same folder.
